_doc: T-263: the arms locker (WeaponLocker, gravelight/world/weapon_locker.gd). Hold [interact] at it: the gun in your hands goes into your own compartment as it is (Crucible tier, attachments, finish, magazine, reserve, fire mode) for store_cost Scrip; a later hold takes it back for withdraw_cost. With a gun inside and your weapon slots full the hold swaps (the held gun in, the stored one out: store_cost + withdraw_cost). One compartment per player, for this match only: it survives going down, bleeding out and the respawn with the starting pistol; a campaign hop carries it to the next map's locker; a new match starts empty. Nothing goes into the profile, so it is open in Classic Rules, Easter Egg Mode and online. keep_on_you = the guns you must still carry after storing (you never lock away your last). no_store = weapon ids or weapon classes the locker refuses (none). sounds = audio.json keys (open, then store or take), db their volume. lamp = the small shadowless lamp over the locker (energy 0 = none). lockers: per map (a map id prefix) {at = the floor point on the wall's face under the locker's middle [x, y, z], yaw = where the doors face (deg: 0 = +z, 90 = +x, 180 = -z, 270 = -x), where = a note for people}. The locker is 0.92 m wide, 1.9 m high and 0.45 m deep, flush on its wall inside the strip the navmesh's agent radius keeps clear (no navmesh change); gravelight/tools_src/locker_spot_probe.gd checks a row (and finds free wall for a new one).

text.take: Hold [%s] to take %s from the locker%s
text.swap: Hold [%s] to lock away %s and take %s%s
text.last_gun: Arms locker: empty (keep one gun on you)
text.refused: Arms locker: %s does not go in
text.duplicate: Arms locker: %s inside (you carry one already)
